versions.changelog:
- Initial release of social-case-to-excel.
- Organizes real social media cases, including original post images, into a multi-sheet Excel library and Markdown/HTML learning documents.
- Uses ClaudeBaby as the sole data source; supports platforms such as Reddit, X, YouTube, and Bilibili (data availability dependent on ClaudeBaby tools).
- Focuses on detailed, reproducible case studies with metadata, evidence, methods, application advice, and verified media.
- Exports structured Excel files (case overview, methods, images, raw data, etc.) following a strict schema; images inserted as available.
- Enforces clear sourcing, tool checks, and strict separation of fact, analysis, and user commentary.
